chapters.title: Before the rain
chapters.story: Heavy rain is approaching Swat. The response team needs observations of the river bend before the next storm.

chapters.title: The roads home
chapters.story: The flood is receding. Map the riverside roads so the recovery team can plan its next survey.

chapters.title: A shared sky
chapters.story: A coastal response team asks for help. Apply what Swat taught you to a new watershed.
